skills.name: Loyal Flock (归鸟/帰鳥)
skills.line: Remember to come back to me!
skills.description:
Kacho Fuugetsu commands the birds around her to peck a single target a number of times based on how many birds she currently has. Each bird deals damage equal to 40% of her attack and has a 50% chance of restoring the ally with the lowest HP by 10% of her max HP.
At the start of her turn or when she has no birds, 1 new bird will be replenished. Max of 2 birds.
Launching a counter-attack sacrifices 1 bird.

upgrades.text: Chance of restoring HP increases to 60%.
Chance of restoring HP increases to 70%.
Chance of restoring HP increases to 60%.

skills.name: Painting Realm (画境/絵巻の世界)
skills.line: The world in my paintings is the world inside my heart!
skills.description: At the end of Kachou Fuugetsu's action, she has a 20% chance of increasing her move bar by 20%. <bf>Unique effect. When she or an ally is inflicted with a control effect, has a 30% chance of sacrificing 1 bird to negate the control effect.

upgrades.text: Chance of triggering the boost to move bar increases to 25%.
Boost to move bar increases to 25%.
Chance of triggering the boost to move bar increases to 30%.
Boost to move bar increases to 30%.

skills.name: Fragrant Flowers (花鸟相闻/花鳥共鳴)
skills.line: Behold the sweet fragrance of my flowers!
skills.description: Kachou Fuugetsu restores the HP of all allies by 8% of her max HP and grants them Nectar, lasts for 2 turns. Nectar restores their HP by 7% and 6% on those turns respectively. ;Nectar (かぐわしい花) : :'''Buff, Mark''': HP is restored before taking an action.
